sections.heading: 1. Overview
paragraphs: This proposal covers a display area of 4480 × 2560 mm using a P2 indoor fixed LED display, with a display area of 11.4688 m² and a native resolution of 2240 × 1280 pixels.
The screen is assembled from 35 cabinets with 224 modules in total. All cabinet sizes come from the company's standard cabinet library; no custom cabinets are required.
Maximum power consumption is 5.73 kW. At 2.5 kW per circuit, 3 power circuits are required, plus 1 spare, for a total of 4 power cables.
The control system is NovaStar. At 560,000 pixels per network port, 6 data runs are required, plus 1 spare, for a total of 7 data cables.
The nearest viewing distance of 3 m suits the P2 pixel pitch.
